A 28-year-old female reports recurrent stereotypical episodes of intense nausea and vomiting lasting 12–24 hours, separated by symptom-free intervals of weeks, with cannabis use. There is no underlying cause on extensive evaluation. What syndromic diagnosis applies and what is the management?

A 50-year-old male had massive small-bowel resection (residual 60 cm of jejunum anastomosed to colon) after mesenteric ischaemia 4 months ago and now presents with high-output stools, weight loss and dehydration. What is the diagnosis, the nutritional strategy, and the role of GLP-2 analogues?

A 45-year-old female with a recent miscarriage and oral contraceptive use presents with new ascites, tender hepatomegaly and right upper quadrant pain. Doppler ultrasound shows absent flow in the hepatic veins. What is the diagnosis, the recommended thrombophilia workup and the initial treatment?

A 65-year-old male on day 6 of mechanical ventilation in the ICU develops new fever, increased oxygen requirement and purulent endotracheal secretions. Chest X-ray shows a new right lower zone infiltrate. Tracheal aspirate culture is pending. What is the diagnosis and empirical antibiotic choice?

A 50-year-old former intravenous drug user is found incidentally to be HCV-antibody positive with HCV RNA 1.2 million IU/mL, genotype 1a, ALT 65 U/L, mild fibrosis on transient elastography. He is treatment-naïve and has no HIV or HBV coinfection. What is the recommended therapy and SVR assessment?

A 24-year-old female presents with 2 days of fever (38.8°C), flank pain, dysuria and one episode of vomiting. Urinalysis shows pyuria and bacteriuria. She is haemodynamically stable, tolerating oral intake, with no comorbidities. What is the diagnosis and the initial antibiotic plan?

A 55-year-old male with poorly controlled diabetes has a deep diabetic foot ulcer with exposed bone visible on probing. MRI shows marrow oedema in the underlying metatarsal head. Bone culture grows Staphylococcus aureus. What is the diagnosis and recommended duration and choice of antibiotics?

A 70-year-old male with a tunnelled haemodialysis catheter develops fever and rigors during dialysis. Two paired peripheral blood cultures and a catheter-drawn culture all grow methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus within 24 hours. What is the diagnosis and the integrated antibiotic plus catheter-management strategy?

A 30-year-old female presents with fever, confusion, behavioural change and a focal seizure. CSF shows lymphocytic pleocytosis, mildly elevated protein and normal glucose. MRI brain shows asymmetric temporal lobe hyperintensity. CSF HSV-1 PCR is positive. What is the diagnosis and immediate therapy?

A 35-year-old male returns from Nigeria with 5 days of fever, rigors, headache and myalgia, and now develops jaundice, oliguria and confusion. Blood film shows ring forms with parasitaemia of 8%. What is the diagnosis, the severity classification and the recommended therapy?

A 35-year-old male with HIV (CD4 35 cells/µL, not on ART) presents with 2 weeks of headache, fever, focal neurological deficit and a single ring-enhancing lesion in the right basal ganglia on MRI. Serum Toxoplasma IgG is positive. What is the diagnosis and empirical treatment?

A 58-year-old male with neutropenia after induction chemotherapy for AML develops fever, pleuritic chest pain and haemoptysis. Chest CT shows multiple nodules with the 'halo sign'. Serum galactomannan is positive. What is the most likely diagnosis and first-line antifungal therapy?

A 40-year-old male with advanced HIV (CD4 25) presents with 2 weeks of headache, fever and altered mental status. CSF opening pressure is 38 cmH2O. India ink stain is positive and CSF cryptococcal antigen is reactive. What is the diagnosis, induction therapy, and management of raised ICP?

A 45-year-old male from the Mississippi river valley presents with months of fevers, weight loss, hepatosplenomegaly and pancytopenia. Bone marrow shows intracellular yeast forms within macrophages and Histoplasma antigen is positive in urine. What is the diagnosis and treatment for disseminated disease?

A 30-year-old pregnant woman (28 weeks) develops fever, myalgia, headache and gastroenteritis-like symptoms after a soft-cheese meal. Blood cultures grow Listeria monocytogenes. What is the diagnosis, fetal implications and recommended therapy?

A 17-year-old male presents 5 days into a sore throat with high fevers, neck swelling and pleuritic chest pain. Contrast CT of the neck shows internal jugular vein thrombosis and chest CT shows multiple cavitating pulmonary septic emboli. Blood cultures grow Fusobacterium necrophorum. What is the syndromic diagnosis and management?

A 60-year-old male with poorly controlled diabetic ketoacidosis presents with right-sided facial swelling, peri-orbital pain and black necrotic eschar on the nasal turbinate. Biopsy shows broad, non-septate hyphae with right-angle branching. What is the diagnosis and the urgent combined surgical-medical management?

A 12-year-old boy presents with rapidly progressive headache, fever and altered consciousness 5 days after swimming in a warm freshwater lake. CSF shows neutrophilic pleocytosis with low glucose and motile trophozoites are seen on wet mount. What is the diagnosis, microbiological agent, and treatment options?

A 50-year-old migrant from Cambodia on long-term corticosteroids for asthma develops abdominal pain, diarrhoea, fever and Gram-negative bacteraemia. Stool wet mount shows filariform larvae. What is the diagnosis, the syndromic complication, and the recommended antiparasitic therapy?

A 40-year-old male from Ghana with no comorbidities presents with a chronic painless undermined ulcer on the left forearm that has slowly extended over months. Biopsy and PCR identify Mycobacterium ulcerans. What is the diagnosis, geographic context, and recommended antimicrobial therapy?

A 25-year-old returned traveller from rural Bangladesh presents with 7 days of stepwise fever (up to 40°C), relative bradycardia, abdominal pain, headache and rose spots on the trunk. Blood culture grows Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi. What is the diagnosis and the recommended antimicrobial therapy?

A 30-year-old hiker in New England returns from a weekend trip with a 7 cm expanding annular erythematous rash on the thigh with central clearing, low-grade fever and fatigue. Serology is not yet available. What is the diagnosis and recommended oral antibiotic therapy?

A 28-year-old male returns from Thailand with 4 days of high fever, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, a transient rash and a positive NS1 antigen. Platelets are 95 and now drop to 60 on day 6 with abdominal pain and rising haematocrit. What is the diagnosis, the warning signs and the recommended supportive management?

A 28-year-old MSM presents with a diffuse non-pruritic maculopapular rash involving the palms and soles, low-grade fever, mucosal patches and condyloma lata. RPR is 1:128 and FTA-ABS is positive. He has no neurological symptoms and HIV testing is pending. What is the staging and recommended therapy?

A 45-year-old male is 6 weeks post allogeneic stem-cell transplant for AML on routine surveillance and develops new fever, transaminitis and a viral load of 12,000 copies/mL of cytomegalovirus DNA. He has no end-organ disease yet. What is the diagnosis and recommended preemptive therapy?

A 65-year-old male with COPD attends for annual review. He has had no prior pneumococcal vaccination, last influenza vaccination 2 years ago, no zoster vaccination, and a recent tetanus booster 5 years ago. He is HIV-negative and not on immunosuppression. What is the routine adult vaccination plan you recommend?

A 70-year-old male with a right total knee replacement performed 3 years ago presents with progressive pain and a small persistent sinus tract draining clear fluid for 4 months. Imaging shows component loosening. Intraoperative cultures grow coagulase-negative Staphylococcus. What is the diagnosis and management approach?

A 45-year-old male has 4 weeks of fever >38.3°C without an obvious source despite an initial outpatient evaluation including standard labs, blood cultures, urine cultures and a chest X-ray. He has lost 4 kg, has mild splenomegaly on examination, and no localising symptoms. What is the framework for further evaluation?

A 40-year-old female on day 10 of induction chemotherapy for AML develops fever 38.5°C, an absolute neutrophil count of 0.3 x 10^9/L and no clinical focus on examination. She is haemodynamically stable. What is the diagnosis, risk stratification, and empirical antibacterial strategy?

A 25-year-old male presents with 2 days of bloody mucoid diarrhoea with tenesmus and high fever 39.4°C following return from rural India. Stool microscopy shows pus and red cells; culture grows Shigella flexneri. What is the diagnosis and recommended antibiotic therapy?

A 60-year-old smoker presents with 6 days of fever, dry cough, diarrhoea and confusion. Chest X-ray shows multilobar consolidation. Sodium is 128 mmol/L, ALT 95. Urinary Legionella antigen is positive. What is the diagnosis and the recommended antibiotic therapy?

A 28-year-old hiker in North Carolina presents with 5 days of high fever, severe headache, myalgia and a centripetal petechial rash involving palms and soles. Platelets are 80, sodium 130, AST 240. A tick bite was reported 7 days ago. What is the diagnosis and empirical antibiotic therapy?

A 75-year-old female on day 4 of a urinary catheter for postoperative urinary retention develops fever 38.6°C, suprapubic pain and confusion. Urine from the catheter shows pyuria with bacteriuria and Gram-negative rods. What is the diagnosis, management plan and prevention strategy?

A 30-year-old farmer presents with 6 days of fever, severe myalgia (especially calves), conjunctival suffusion, jaundice and acute kidney injury after wading in flood water. CK is 6000 and platelets 50. What is the diagnosis and recommended antibiotic therapy?

A 45-year-old male with a bioprosthetic mitral valve presents with 5 months of low-grade fever, weight loss and embolic stroke. Three sets of routine blood cultures are negative; PCR on excised valve tissue detects Tropheryma whipplei. What is the diagnosis, the rationale for the diagnostic approach, and the recommended therapy?

A 50-year-old male sheep farmer from rural Greece presents with right upper quadrant pain and a 12 cm well-circumscribed cystic liver lesion on ultrasound with daughter cysts and a calcified rim. Eosinophilia is mild and serology for Echinococcus is positive. What is the diagnosis, classification, and treatment options?

A 50-year-old unvaccinated male sustained a deep puncture wound from rusty metal 5 days ago and now presents with trismus, neck stiffness, painful muscle spasms and risus sardonicus. He is alert and fully conscious. What is the diagnosis and the urgent management priorities?

A 40-year-old veterinarian working with cattle presents with undulating fevers, drenching night sweats, arthralgia, and hepatosplenomegaly for 6 weeks. Blood cultures (held for prolonged incubation) grow Brucella melitensis. What is the diagnosis and the recommended antibiotic combination?
